Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the performer of “Hunter (Björk song)” by applying an incorrect “track-specific credits” heuristic that treated Mark Bell (a collaborator/producer) as the performer instead of Björk. This contradicted both the task framing (which explicitly references the Björk song) and the WebSurfer’s findings indicating Björk’s birthplace is Reykjavík, Iceland. This role confusion led to the wrong final answer (Leeds, England).
